hiring.positions_note: None open today for an academic post, including Medicine/Internal Medicine. The live listings include one still-open 44-hour internal-mobility professional post supporting/teaching Ingeniería en Finanzas, closing 4 September 2026; it is restricted to UV plant/contract staff and is not an academic vacancy. The two other listed non-academic calls closed 2 September 2026.
hiring.requires_chilean_title_note: No open academic post was published. UV's academic-applicant rules say: “Copia digital de la cédula nacional de identidad, documento de identificación de país de origen o pasaporte, en caso de postulantes extranjeros” and require a copy of the relevant professional title/degree; they do not state Chilean nationality or revalidación. The only live internal professional call states: “Ser ciudadano; no obstante, en casos de excepción ... podrá designarse ... a extranjeros que posean conocimientos científicos o de carácter especial.” Its stated eligibility is internal UV staff.

international.notes: The Medicina curriculum includes an English subject, but no official source located confirms that a medical discipline is currently taught in English. UV described Toxicology in English (Faculty of Pharmacy) as its first wholly English-taught undergraduate course in 2024. Medicina has exchange places with the University of the Basque Country, Medical University of Graz and University of Lille; the faculty page says exchange also concerns academics.

profile_paragraphs: UV’s Faculty of Medicine traces its origins to a nursing school founded in 1933. University of Chile began medical courses in Valparaíso in 1961; the institution adopted the Universidad de Valparaíso name in 1981.
The faculty is headquartered at Angamos 655 in Reñaca, Viña del Mar. Its Medicine school lists a seven-year CNA undergraduate accreditation on its official site.
For Medicine clinical training, UV names public and naval hospitals in Valparaíso/Viña del Mar and the Aconcagua area, including Gustavo Fricke, Carlos van Buren, Eduardo Pereira and San Camilo.

UV runs a face-to-face adult Rheumatology medical subspecialty. Its listed clinical fields include Hospital Gustavo Fricke, Hospital Naval and H.C.V.B.; foreign medical degrees require revalidation for programme admission.

For a foreign academic applicant, the live academic-vacancy portal showed no open academic post on 3 September 2026. UV’s general academic rules expressly accept a passport or country-of-origin ID for foreign applicants, but this is separate from clinical licensing requirements.
